name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI Serverless Quickstart end-to-end. Installed the OpenAI Python SDK, created a script following the quickstart instructions, and received a chat completion response from a Fireworks-hosted model. The API call returned a Spanish greeting response as expected.
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, but that model returned a 404 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed' error. I listed available models via the API and used `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-flash-0731` instead, which worked and returned the chat completion.
